reason_for_revision: Repeated v2 FASTEST runs with the same seed, map, order files, route paths, SUMO seed, and protocol produced different traffic-state timestamps and completion outcomes. V3 freezes previously measured per-order route-planning delays and replays them on the SUMO clock, while separately recording live planner wall time.

planning_delay.definition: For each order, apply its frozen measured planner_wall_time_s from the source R1 run as virtual route-planning delay. SUMO signals, background traffic, and other active vehicles continue during this delay; the logical vehicle waits until the delay has elapsed before it departs.
planning_delay.reason: Keep planning time in simulated completion time while preventing host-load variation in a live perf_counter measurement from changing signal phases and traffic interactions across repeats.

interpretation_limits: Traffic, signal phases, and energy remain SUMO simulation outputs; they are not observed Porto real-time states.
The frozen planning delays are measured R1 latencies replayed as virtual delay. Live wall time is separately reported and is not used to advance SUMO in v3.
The 90 vehicles/hour background flow is a synthetic stress assumption shaped by historical taxi hotspot weights.
A completed R1 v3 matrix will not by itself establish an AI map-readability effect; LLM and representation-control runs are separate and pending.
